theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ p : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (θ : Rn (n + ℓ) → ℝ) (f : Rn (n + ℓ) → Rn p) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn (n + ℓ)), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight n M θ → IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → (∀ u ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ u)) → ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), u ∈ V → ψ u ∈ M → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ (ψ u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap) ∧ DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u ∧ ∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)
